name: @npv12/opencode-footer
description: OpenCode2 prompt footer + quota status. Merges the opencode-tps prompt stats (TPS/TTFT) with the opencode-quota compact status into one footer plugin, plus the quota_status server tool. Ported from @npv12/opencode-quota v1 (server + TUI entries) to the opencode2 next-16664/16665 Promise-plugin API. Providers trimmed to opencode-go, hyper, and openai (Codex).
